Image prompt:
Photograph, straight-on eye-level view into an empty Japanese tokonoma alcove. A pale warm-grey lime plaster back wall fills most of the frame, smooth and matte with faint trowel texture. A dark weathered pine post runs the full height along the right edge. The bottom fifth of the frame is a dark polished wooden floor board running edge to edge. On the board, about two-thirds of the way across from the left, sits a shallow round dark bronze basin holding one rounded grey stone the size of a melon, covered in dense green cushion moss. Three or four small red Japanese maple leaves have fallen on the moss and the board. The entire left half of the frame is empty plaster wall. Soft diffused daylight from a paper screen out of frame on the left, gentle shadow falling to the right. Muted, natural colours, quiet and calm. Shot on a 50mm lens, f/5.6, high detail, realistic. No text, no people, no other objects, no HDR, not oversaturated. 16:9.
